releases.notes:
This is a preview release of Enchanted Vertical Slabs v2 for 1.20.6 with support for fabric and neoforge. This version is meant to test v2 before Minecraft 1.21

## Please read before using
- This version should be compatible with world made with older versions of Enchanted Vertical Slabs, however, you should make backups just in case.
- If you are on Fabric, make sure to install the Fabric API mod alongside this mod.
- If you are on NeoForge, make sure you are using the latest release (anything above `20.6.100-beta` should work)

## Significant changes since [v1.10.4](https://github.com/Enchanted-Games/vertical-slabs/releases/tag/1.10.4)
- The modid is now `evs` instead of `enchanted-vertical-slabs`, however, the mod still uses the `enchanted-vertical-slabs` namespace for all blocks, items, data, etc.
- This modid is subject to change for the full 1.21 release of Enchanted Vertical Slabs v2

## Bug fixes & changes
- Wooden vertical slabs can now be used as furnace fuel
- Cherry vertical slabs can now catch fire
- Glass panes and walls no longer connect to the empty space of a vertical slab block (see image)
![image](https://github.com/Enchanted-Games/enchanted-vertical-slabs/assets/58823778/4b0a2509-c1f4-4c45-957d-7b88a74e8d06)
- Vertical slabs are no longer in the `#minecraft:walls` block tag, they are still in `#enchanted-vertical-slabs:slabs`

## Known issues
- Vertical slabs aren't next to their regular slabs in the creative inventory on NeoForge #1
- Wax On and Wax Off advancements aren't granted for vertical slabs #2
